evidence.quote: The language of instruction is English, ensuring accessibility for international students.
At Hof University, no tuition fees are charged for our Bachelor's and Master's programs.
The following is valid for applicants from: all countries For the winter semester: 15 April - 15 July
The application period is between April 15 - July 15.

notes: applicationChannel: the programme page says application is via the portal 'Primuss', not uni-assist, but Primuss is not one of the allowed channel values; 'nl-studielink' was chosen only because the allowed list contains no German university-direct value, so this should be verified by a human. The deadline '15 April - 15 July' is given for 'applicants from: all countries', not specifically for non-EU applicants, so it is recorded as a recurring deadline without a year; note the university's own deadlines table gives a different non-EU winter deadline (May 1 - July 15) for most programmes, which may or may not apply to this one. The DAAD page gives a semester contribution of approx. 150 EUR and the German finance page gives a semester fee of 145 EUR; these are not tuition and were left out. The language certificates may be submitted by September 15 (see programme page), which is a soft rule left out.

evidence.quote: English language skills B2 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: IELTS Academic: 6.5 TOEFL iBT (before 2026): 90
German language skills, proven by official test score documents - minimum level A1

note.fr: Votre certificat d'accès à l'université obtenu à l'étranger doit être évalué par uni-assist avant votre candidature à Hof University.
note.en: Your university entrance certificate obtained abroad must be assessed by uni-assist before you can apply at Hof University.

evidence.quote: If you acquired your university entrance certificate abroad, uni-assist must assess your certificate before you can send it to Hof University.
